# AWS VPC

This plugin collects read-only AWS VPC networking data from EC2 and CloudWatch Logs, evaluates CCF Rego policy bundles, and emits evidence back through the CCF agent.

This page is for **operators** who run the `plugin-aws-vpc` plugin with the CCF Agent, and for **developers** who write policies for it. It documents [v0.3.3](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-vpc/releases/tag/v0.3.3) and is generated from the plugin's [README at v0.3.3](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-vpc/blob/v0.3.3/README.md).

## How it works

### How it fits in CCF

The CCF agent starts this binary through HashiCorp `go-plugin`, passes configuration and policy paths over gRPC, and receives generated evidence through the runner callback. This repository does not call the CCF API directly.

## Configuration

The plugin expects:

- AWS credentials through the default AWS SDK credential chain
- target regions from `config.regions` or `config.region`
- `AWS_REGION` as a fallback when plugin config does not provide a region

Any agent-supplied `policy_data` is passed through to Rego as `data.*`.

## Evidence collected

### Supported resource families

The collector can evaluate policies for:

- VPCs
- subnets
- security groups
- network ACLs
- route tables

### Data collected

Depending on the selected policy bundles, the plugin can collect and correlate:

- VPCs and VPC attributes
- DHCP options
- subnets
- route tables
- internet gateways
- VPC endpoints
- security groups
- network ACLs
- flow logs
- related CloudWatch log groups
- transit gateway attachments
- network interfaces

## Policy input

The plugin evaluates five kinds of resource, and a policy receives one document of the matching kind as `input`. Each document has two top-level keys: the resource itself, as the AWS API returns it, and a context object the plugin builds from the other VPC data it collected in the same region. A bundle is matched to a kind by its name: `aws-vpc-policies` (`vpc`), `aws-vpc-subnet-policies` (`subnet`), `aws-vpc-sg-policies` (`sg`), `aws-vpc-nacl-policies` (`acl`) or `aws-vpc-rt-policies` (`rt`). The resource objects and every list of related resources use the AWS SDK for Go field names, which are capitalised (`VpcId`, `CidrBlock`, `Tags` with `Key` and `Value`), and a value AWS did not return is `null`. The `current` object in each context holds the plugin's own summary, in snake_case. The tables list the keys of every kind, and the example shows one trimmed document of each kind under the key named after its bundle behavior; a real input is only the document itself, without that key.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `vpc` | object | VPC kind. The EC2 VPC (`VpcId`, `CidrBlock`, `DhcpOptionsId`, `IsDefault`, `State`, `Tags`, and the other fields of the EC2 `Vpc` type). |
| `vpc_context.current` | object | VPC kind. Summary with `vpc_id` (string), `region` (string), `cidr_block` (string), `dhcp_options_id` (string), `is_default` (boolean), `state` (string) and `tags_present` (boolean). |
| `vpc_context.attributes` | object | VPC kind. `enable_dns_support`, `enable_dns_hostnames` and `enable_network_address_usage_metrics`, each a boolean. A key is left out when AWS did not return it. |
| `vpc_context.dhcp_options` | object or null | VPC kind. The DHCP options set attached to the VPC, or `null` when there is none. |
| `vpc_context.subnets_in_vpc` | array of objects | VPC kind. EC2 subnets in the VPC. |
| `vpc_context.route_tables_in_vpc` | array of objects | VPC kind. EC2 route tables in the VPC. |
| `vpc_context.internet_gateways_for_vpc` | array of objects | VPC kind. Internet gateways attached to the VPC. |
| `vpc_context.vpc_endpoints_for_vpc` | array of objects | VPC kind. VPC endpoints in the VPC. |
| `vpc_context.flow_logs_for_vpc` | array of objects | VPC kind. Flow logs whose `ResourceId` is the VPC. |
| `vpc_context.log_groups_for_vpc_flow_logs` | array of objects | VPC kind. CloudWatch log groups that those flow logs publish to. |
| `vpc_context.transit_gateway_attachments_for_vpc` | array of objects | VPC kind. Transit gateway attachments whose `ResourceId` is the VPC. |
| `subnet` | object | Subnet kind. The EC2 subnet (`SubnetId`, `VpcId`, `CidrBlock`, `AvailabilityZone`, `MapPublicIpOnLaunch`, `Tags`, and the other fields of the EC2 `Subnet` type). |
| `subnet_context.current` | object | Subnet kind. Summary with `subnet_id`, `vpc_id`, `region`, `availability_zone`, `availability_zone_id`, `cidr_block` and `state` (strings), `ipv6_cidr_block_count` and `available_ip_address_count` (integers), `map_public_ip_on_launch` and `tags_present` (booleans). |
| `subnet_context.vpc` | object or null | Subnet kind. The VPC that contains the subnet. |
| `subnet_context.route_tables_in_vpc` | array of objects | Subnet kind. Route tables in the subnet's VPC. |
| `subnet_context.route_table_for_subnet` | object or null | Subnet kind. The route table the subnet uses: the one it is explicitly associated with, otherwise the VPC's main route table, otherwise `null`. |
| `subnet_context.explicit_route_table_association` | boolean | Subnet kind. True when a route table is explicitly associated with the subnet. |
| `subnet_context.network_acls_for_subnet` | array of objects | Subnet kind. Network ACLs associated with the subnet. |
| `subnet_context.internet_gateways_for_vpc` | array of objects | Subnet kind. Internet gateways attached to the subnet's VPC. |
| `subnet_context.flow_logs_for_vpc` | array of objects | Subnet kind. Flow logs on the subnet's VPC. |
| `subnet_context.flow_logs_for_subnet` | array of objects | Subnet kind. Flow logs on the subnet itself. |
| `subnet_context.log_groups_for_related_flow_logs` | array of objects | Subnet kind. CloudWatch log groups that the VPC and subnet flow logs publish to. |
| `security_group` | object | Security group kind. The EC2 security group (`GroupId`, `GroupName`, `VpcId`, `IpPermissions`, `IpPermissionsEgress`, `Tags`, and the other fields of the EC2 `SecurityGroup` type). |
| `sg_context.current` | object | Security group kind. Summary with `group_id`, `group_name`, `vpc_id` and `region` (strings), `is_default` (boolean, true when the group is named `default`) and `tags_present` (boolean). |
| `sg_context.vpc` | object or null | Security group kind. The VPC that contains the group. |
| `sg_context.security_groups_in_vpc` | array of objects | Security group kind. Every security group in the VPC. |
| `sg_context.attached_network_interfaces` | array of objects | Security group kind. Network interfaces that use the group. |
| `sg_context.attached_subnets` | array of objects | Security group kind. Subnets of those network interfaces. |
| `sg_context.route_tables_in_vpc` | array of objects | Security group kind. Route tables in the VPC. |
| `sg_context.route_tables_for_attached_subnets` | array of objects | Security group kind. Route tables that apply to the attached subnets. |
| `sg_context.network_acls_in_vpc` | array of objects | Security group kind. Network ACLs in the VPC. |
| `sg_context.network_acls_for_attached_subnets` | array of objects | Security group kind. Network ACLs associated with the attached subnets. |
| `sg_context.internet_gateways_for_vpc` | array of objects | Security group kind. Internet gateways attached to the VPC. |
| `sg_context.vpc_endpoints_for_vpc` | array of objects | Security group kind. VPC endpoints in the VPC. |
| `sg_context.flow_logs_for_related_resources` | array of objects | Security group kind. Flow logs on the VPC, the attached subnets or the attached network interfaces. |
| `sg_context.log_groups_for_related_flow_logs` | array of objects | Security group kind. CloudWatch log groups of those flow logs. |
| `sg_context.transit_gateway_attachments_for_vpc` | array of objects | Security group kind. Transit gateway attachments of the VPC. |
| `network_acl` | object | Network ACL kind. The EC2 network ACL (`NetworkAclId`, `VpcId`, `IsDefault`, `Entries`, `Associations`, `Tags`, and the other fields of the EC2 `NetworkAcl` type). |
| `nacl_context.current` | object | Network ACL kind. Summary with `network_acl_id`, `vpc_id` and `region` (strings), `is_default`, `has_subnet_associations` and `tags_present` (booleans), `association_count` and `entry_count` (integers), and `associated_subnet_ids` (sorted array of strings). |
| `nacl_context.vpc` | object or null | Network ACL kind. The VPC that contains the ACL. |
| `nacl_context.associated_subnets` | array of objects | Network ACL kind. Subnets the ACL is associated with. |
| `nacl_context.route_tables_in_vpc` | array of objects | Network ACL kind. Route tables in the VPC. |
| `nacl_context.route_tables_for_associated_subnets` | array of objects | Network ACL kind. Route tables that apply to the associated subnets. |
| `nacl_context.internet_gateways_for_vpc` | array of objects | Network ACL kind. Internet gateways attached to the VPC. |
| `nacl_context.flow_logs_for_vpc` | array of objects | Network ACL kind. Flow logs on the VPC. |
| `nacl_context.flow_logs_for_associated_subnets` | array of objects | Network ACL kind. Flow logs on the associated subnets. |
| `nacl_context.log_groups_for_related_flow_logs` | array of objects | Network ACL kind. CloudWatch log groups of those flow logs. |
| `nacl_context.network_interfaces_in_associated_subnets` | array of objects | Network ACL kind. Network interfaces in the associated subnets. |
| `route_table` | object | Route table kind. The EC2 route table (`RouteTableId`, `VpcId`, `OwnerId`, `Routes`, `Associations`, `PropagatingVgws`, `Tags`, and the other fields of the EC2 `RouteTable` type). |
| `route_table_context.current` | object | Route table kind. Summary. Strings: `route_table_id`, `vpc_id`, `owner_id`, `region`. Integers: `association_count`, `explicit_subnet_association_count`, `implicit_subnet_association_count`, `effective_subnet_association_count`, `gateway_association_count`, `route_count`, `blackhole_route_count`, `propagating_vgw_count`. Arrays of strings: `explicitly_associated_subnet_ids`, `implicitly_associated_subnet_ids`, `effectively_associated_subnet_ids`, `gateway_association_ids`. Booleans: `is_main`, `has_blackhole_routes`, `has_ipv4_default_route_to_internet_gateway`, `has_ipv6_default_route_to_internet_gateway`, `has_default_route_to_internet_gateway`, `has_ipv6_default_route_to_egress_only_gateway`, `has_default_route_to_nat_gateway`, `has_default_route_to_transit_gateway`, `has_default_route_to_vpc_peering_connection`, `has_gateway_endpoint_routes`, `tags_present`. Only the main route table has implicit subnets: the subnets of the VPC that no route table is explicitly associated with. |
| `route_table_context.vpc` | object or null | Route table kind. The VPC that contains the route table. |
| `route_table_context.subnets_in_vpc` | array of objects | Route table kind. Subnets in the VPC. |
| `route_table_context.explicitly_associated_subnets` | array of objects | Route table kind. Subnets explicitly associated with the route table. |
| `route_table_context.implicitly_associated_subnets` | array of objects | Route table kind. Subnets that use the route table because it is the main one. |
| `route_table_context.effectively_associated_subnets` | array of objects | Route table kind. The explicit and implicit subnets together. |
| `route_table_context.internet_gateways_for_vpc` | array of objects | Route table kind. Internet gateways attached to the VPC. |
| `route_table_context.vpc_endpoints_for_vpc` | array of objects | Route table kind. VPC endpoints in the VPC. |
| `route_table_context.vpc_endpoints_for_route_table` | array of objects | Route table kind. VPC endpoints that list this route table in `RouteTableIds`. |
| `route_table_context.transit_gateway_attachments_for_vpc` | array of objects | Route table kind. Transit gateway attachments of the VPC. |
| `route_table_context.route_summaries` | array of objects | Route table kind. One entry per route, with `destination` (CIDR or prefix list ID, empty when unknown), `destination_type` (`ipv4_cidr`, `ipv6_cidr`, `prefix_list` or `unknown`), `target_type` (such as `gateway`, `nat_gateway`, `transit_gateway`, `vpc_peering_connection`, `egress_only_internet_gateway`, or `unknown`), `target_id`, `state` (`active` or `blackhole`) and `origin`. |
| `route_table_context.blackhole_routes` | array of objects | Route table kind. The entries of `route_summaries` whose `state` is `blackhole`. |

## Subject templates

The subject templates this plugin registers. Each example is built from sample data.

### aws-vpc

A VPC. Title: `AWS VPC {{ .vpc_id }} in {{ .region }}`. The evidence also carries `type`, `vpc_id` and `cidr` labels that are not part of the identity.

| Identity key | Description |
|---|---|
| `provider` | Cloud provider. Always `aws`. |
| `region` | AWS region. |
| `vpc_id` | VPC ID. |

Example:

```json
{
  "name": "aws-vpc",
  "type": "component",
  "title": "AWS VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f60718 in eu-west-1",
  "description": "Amazon VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f60718 with CIDR 10.20.0.0/16 in AWS region eu-west-1.",
  "purpose": "Represents an AWS VPC evaluated for networking compliance posture.",
  "identityLabels": {
    "provider": "aws",
    "region": "eu-west-1",
    "vpc_id": "vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f60718"
  }
}
```

### aws-vpc-subnet

A VPC subnet. Title: `AWS subnet {{ .subnet_id }} in {{ .region }}`. The evidence also carries `type`, `vpc_id`, `cidr` and `az` labels that are not part of the identity.

| Identity key | Description |
|---|---|
| `provider` | Cloud provider. Always `aws`. |
| `region` | AWS region. |
| `subnet_id` | Subnet ID. |

Example:

```json
{
  "name": "aws-vpc-subnet",
  "type": "component",
  "title": "AWS subnet subnet-0f1e2d3c4b5a69788 in eu-west-1",
  "description": "Amazon VPC subnet subnet-0f1e2d3c4b5a69788 in VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f60718 with CIDR 10.20.1.0/24.",
  "purpose": "Represents an AWS VPC subnet evaluated for network segmentation and routing posture.",
  "identityLabels": {
    "provider": "aws",
    "region": "eu-west-1",
    "subnet_id": "subnet-0f1e2d3c4b5a69788"
  }
}
```

## Policies

The policy bundles that work with this plugin, at their newest releases. The controls are the ones the bundle's policies list in their metadata.

| Bundle | Latest version | Controls covered | Compatible plugin lines |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`plugin-aws-vpc-nacl-policies`](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-vpc-nacl-policies) | `v0.1.1` | *none listed* | latest |
| [`plugin-aws-vpc-policies`](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-vpc-policies) | `v0.1.1` | *none listed* | latest |
| [`plugin-aws-vpc-rt-policies`](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-vpc-rt-policies) | `v0.1.1` | *none listed* | latest |
| [`plugin-aws-vpc-sg-policies`](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-vpc-sg-policies) | `v0.3.1` | *none listed* | latest |
| [`plugin-aws-vpc-subnet-policies`](https://github.com/compliance-framework/plugin-aws-vpc-subnet-policies) | `v0.1.1` | *none listed* | latest |

### Default policy bundle mapping

| Repository | Behavior | Primary input |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plugin-aws-vpc-policies` | `vpc` | `input.vpc` + `input.vpc_context` |
| `plugin-aws-vpc-subnet-policies` | `subnet` | `input.subnet` + `input.subnet_context` |
| `plugin-aws-vpc-sg-policies` | `sg` | `input.security_group` + `input.sg_context` |
| `plugin-aws-vpc-nacl-policies` | `acl` | `input.network_acl` + `input.nacl_context` |
| `plugin-aws-vpc-rt-policies` | `rt` | `input.route_table` + `input.route_table_context` |
